modelName: RandomForestRegressor with Ridge and form baselines
target: fixture-level FPL points, aggregated over the next five gameweeks

metricGlossary.predicted_next_gw: Projected points for the next gameweek, including captain-free appearance risk and fixture difficulty.
metricGlossary.predicted_next5: Projected points across the next five gameweeks, summing every scheduled fixture in that window.
metricGlossary.transfer_score: A ranking score for transfer targets: projected points plus fixture/value upside, less availability and minutes risk.
metricGlossary.risk_score: A caution score driven by minutes, start likelihood, injury status, and missing recent evidence. Lower is safer.
metricGlossary.fixture_ease: A flipped fixture difficulty measure where larger numbers mean an easier upcoming run.
metricGlossary.optimizer_value: Projected five-gameweek points per million of current FPL price.

diagnostics.note: 2026-27 live FPL data is authoritative; 2025-26 priors are used only where stable player/team codes match.
